comment: Source read at okay-synthesizer-vcvrack commit e06a976, the head of main; two commits carry version 2.0.1 and the only difference between them is the license string in plugin.json, so the code is the same either way. Channel A is the left column and channel B the right, and the two are identical, so each line is written for whichever control was clicked and tagged from both. The morph never reaches a full square: at the top of the knob's travel the saw is blended only 0.8 of the way toward the square, which LowStepperLfo.cpp:62 says is deliberate. In sync the Start and End knobs are quantised by getDividerFromPosition (LowStepperLfo.cpp:104) to nine positions, the first of which is 0. Synced rate uses a multiplier of 0.5 at slow, 8 at med and 64 at fast, divided by a whole number from 16 down to 1 taken from the Rate knob. The two lights between the knobs show each channel's output, green above 0V and red below; they are lights and cannot be clicked. The unused ramp() waveform in LowStepperLfo.cpp is not reachable from any control.
